newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA says won't panic if inflation off target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA says won't panic if inflation off target.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia governor Ian Macfarlane said on Wednesday the bank would not be panicked into a hypothetical early monetary tightening if inflation rose above its target range.
"We wouldn't be panicked into that sort of reaction," Macfarlane told an economic conference.
The Reserve Bank of Australia has an underlying inflation target of two to three percent on average over the economic cycle.
Macfarlane replaced Bernie Fraser as RBA governor last week.
